headline: Braloha farm worker
title: Braloha | Planting And Gathering Five | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want one Pal to run your farm in Palworld one point zero? Braloha is a Grass and Ground Pal that works Planting level five and Gathering level five, plus Mining level three. One worker can plant crops and also harvest berries and plants. It is a big, tough helper for any base. Will you give Braloha your garden? Comment below!
description: Braloha in Palworld 1.0 is a Grass and Ground Pal with Planting level five, Gathering level five and Mining level three.
joke: Braloha says it just wants to grow on you.
